افتعلن (form VIII)
# اِفْتَعَلْنَ (iftaʕalna) /if.ta.ʕal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
# اُفْتُعِلْنَ (uftuʕilna) /uf.tu.ʕil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
# اِفْتَعِلْنَ (iftaʕilna) /if.ta.ʕil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِفْتَعَلَ (iftaʕala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
